Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The expert finalized “Bored to Death” as the worst-rated series by inferring it was below “Cheers” without retrieving its actual Rotten Tomatoes score and without validating the candidate set (omitting CSI: Cyber). This misuses incomplete data to produce a definitive conclusion, making recovery difficult. Earlier omissions were still recoverable, but this step locked in the wrong answer.
